facts.name: Jennifer Alcorta Waters
facts.assignment: Profile: one-third Martin County Court; Mental Health Court; assists felony drug court; supervises civil traffic magistrates; assists25% circuit civil nonjury from filing, excluding residential/commercial mortgage foreclosure; Election Canvassing Board.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number/name and subject; copy all parties. Phone is alternative office contact.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email assistant for civil dates, coordinate opposing party before notice; file and serve notice immediately, ordinarily at least five working days ahead. Notify assistant and file/serve cancellation. Clerk schedules small-claims pretrials.

conferral.summary: Hearing notice requires signed certification of personal effort to resolve; written communication suffices if attempted personal contact fails.

proposed_orders.summary: Word with cover letter identifying agreement/disagreement; mail with copies/stamped envelopes, or email assistant copying all when everyone has email. Bring proposed order to hearing; submit by court date or within ten days when none specified.

courtesy_copies.summary: Before civil hearing provide motion/order/notice and highlighted authority. Evidentiary legal materials at least five days ahead, copied to all; fewer than twenty pages may be emailed, voluminous materials mailed, preferably binder.

remote_appearances.summary: Written request at least ten days before hearing; notice includes Zoom credentials. Small-claims attendance statements vary within profile; retain exception/approval language without assuming permission.

facts.summary: Practical civil scheduling, submission and appearance instructions reviewed; noncivil programs retained as assignments only.

conflicts.subject: Small-claims remote attendance
statements: Scheduling section allows specific exceptions approved at least five days before pretrial.
Remote section says all small-claims pretrials and trials require personal attendance; general remote requests at least ten days before hearing.
conflicts.disposition: Preserve each statement and scope; no controlling rule inferred.

review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts, assignment and recurring civil operating requirements.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Motion-specific litigation recipes, noncivil program procedures, trial mechanics, linked forms and calendars. Printable duplicate procedures retained as link only.

citations.locator: Contacts, assignment and recurring operating sections; remote-attendance variations retained
